en.title: Minister Zareer Meets with IsDB Delegation
en.description: Minister Hassan Zareer and senior officials of the Ministry met today with the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) delegation, led by Mr. Muhammad Nassis bin Sulaiman, Head of the IsDB Regional Hub (Bangladesh and Maldives), and Mr. Iftekhar Alam, Senior Manager of the International Islamic Trade…
en.body:
![](https://www.finance.gov.mv/public/attachments/hounlvR1JbQsaMUXbZrQi06WZFWjpJFiZAugz2NT.jpg)Minister Hassan Zareer and senior officials of the Ministry met today with the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) delegation, led by Mr. Muhammad Nassis bin Sulaiman, Head of the IsDB Regional Hub (Bangladesh and Maldives), and Mr. Iftekhar Alam, Senior Manager of the International Islamic Trade Finance Corporation (ITFC).

Discussions focused on the strategic direction of the Maldives’ new Member Country Partnership Strategy (MCPS) 2026–2030 and opportunities to further strengthen cooperation between the Government of Maldives and the Islamic Development Bank Group in support of the country’s development priorities.The IsDB has been a longstanding development partner of the Maldives, supporting key national priorities through financing, technical assistance, and capacity-building initiatives across various sectors.

en.title: Minister expresses gratitude for China’s emergency assistance and reaffirms commitment to Maldives–China partnership
en.description: Minister of Finance and Planning, Moosa Zameer, today led the Government of Maldives’ expression of gratitude to the People’s Republic of China for the emergency assistance extended following the recent fire incident that disrupted operations across several government ministries.
en.body:
Minister of Finance and Planning, Moosa Zameer, today led the Government of Maldives’ expression of gratitude to the People’s Republic of China for the emergency assistance extended following the recent fire incident that disrupted operations across several government ministries.

Speaking at the official handover ceremony, Minister Zameer underscored the importance of the support provided by the Chinese Government, noting that the assistance—valued at USD 2.8 million—will play a key role in restoring essential government functions. The emergency package includes urgently needed office equipment and furniture to replace resources lost in the incident.

Minister Zameer emphasised that China’s swift response reflects not only practical support but also the depth of the bilateral relationship. He highlighted the longstanding cooperation between the Maldives and China, with collaboration spanning infrastructure, development financing, and capacity building. He further noted that President Dr Mohamed Muizzu’s recent visits to China, including meetings with President Xi Jinping, have strengthened trust and broadened the scope of partnership.

“The Maldives and China share a strong and enduring friendship. Today’s assistance is a clear sign of true partnership, and it will significantly ease the challenges faced by the affected ministries. We are sincerely grateful for this timely and generous support,” Minister Zameer stated.

During the ceremony, Minister Zameer signed the Handover Certificate alongside the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to the Maldives, Kong Xianhua, formally marking the transfer of assistance to the Government of Maldives. He affirmed the Maldives’ commitment to further expanding cooperation with China for the mutual benefit of both countries.

en.title: The International Monetary Fund has issued a Press Release following the 2019 Article IV mission to Maldives
en.description: The International Monetary Fund has issued a Press Release following the 2019 Article IV mission to Maldives.
en.body:
The International Monetary Fund has issued a Press Release following the 2019 Article IV mission to Maldives.

An International Monetary Fund team, led by Mr. Philippe Karam, visited Malé from February 20-March 5, 2019 for the 2019 Article IV consultation. The team met with the Minister of Finance, Mr. Ibrahim Ameer, Governor of Maldives Monetary Authority, Mr. Ahmed Naseer, Cabinet ministers and senior officials, the Attorney General, the Majlis Economic Affairs and Public Finance Committees, banks, private sector representatives, development partners, and civil society members.

[IMF Press Release No. PR19/64](https://www.imf.org/en/News/Articles/2019/03/05/PR1964)

en.title: Launching of “Beelan Portal”, “Neelan Portal” and new features of Bandeyri Portal
en.description: T he Ministry of Finance and Treasury launches government procurement portal – “Beelan Portal”, and a portal for centralized government inventory management – “Neelan Portal”. Two new features of Bandeyri Portal were also introduced, enabling more effective PSIP monitoring and a more efficient…
en.body:
The Ministry of Finance and Treasury launches government procurement portal – “Beelan Portal”, and a portal for centralized government inventory management – “Neelan Portal”. Two new features of Bandeyri Portal were also introduced, enabling more effective PSIP monitoring and a more efficient method of utility payments.

Ministry of Finance and Treasury launches “Beelan Portal” and “Neelan Portal”

Ministry of Finance and Treasury launches government procurement portal – “Beelan Portal”, and a portal for government inventory management – “Neelan Portal”, along with two new features of Bandeyri Portal: utility payments and PSIP monitoring.
